download_query_generator_model: download the BlenderBot2 query generator model to the specified datapath directory
run_download_function: run the download function to fetch the query_generator model.tgz for BB2
check_model_built_status: check if the query_generator model is already built using the built function
get_model_directory: get the model directory path for BlenderBot2 using get_model_dir with a datapath
download_models_with_options: download models using download_models with opt, fnames, and use_model_type settings
